card.name: US election dates and years
card.fires_on: Small words and year digits just before an election date or year, in text about US presidential elections and voting, such as the space before an election day number or 'in' before 2008.

card.writes: It pushes toward month and year-like tokens, especially November and East Asian calendar characters, so a date or election year comes next.
card.plain: It fires when an election-related passage is about to give a date or year, such as November or 2008.
